descriptions.w3d_d30e_voice_update_801e6054: Per-frame voice update. While starting, polls each claimed channel of the table at 0x8045dbc8, copies the decoded header from the DMA buffer into a 48-byte stream block, counts ready channels and, once all are ready, opens a mono or stereo stream at the configured volume. Otherwise applies volume and facing mix to the open stream, reopens a looping stream if needed, and when the voice stops releases its source and returns 0. Names are inferred.
